name: library-service
description: Holds the team library's fixed in-memory catalogue of about 15 books (title, author, genre, year, available) and serves two read-only lookups: searchBooks (GET /books, optional genre/author filters) and getBook (GET /books/{id}). Never adds, edits, removes, or persists a book — the catalogue is seeded once at startup and there is no database. Called only by book-buddy on behalf of a signed-in Team Member; it never runs a checkout or reservation workflow.
